headline: **MLB Daily Recap: July 28, 2026**
article:
The Texas Rangers secured a 7-3 victory over the Seattle Mariners, with Kumar Rocker earning the win after 6.2 innings of work. Joc Pederson led the Mariners' offense with two home runs and four RBIs. In other action, the Baltimore Orioles took down the Detroit Tigers 8-5, with Coby Mayo leading the charge at the plate. The Pittsburgh Pirates secured a 3-2 victory over the Arizona Diamondbacks, with Mason Montgomery earning the win. Max Kepler led the Diamondbacks' offense with 3 hits and 2 RBIs. The Miami Marlins edged out the Philadelphia Phillies 8-7 in a back-and-forth game.

Several key players have been placed on the injured list, including Kerry Carpenter of the Detroit Tigers, who has been placed on the 10-day injured list due to left foot plantar fasciitis. Other players on the injured list include Spencer Steer of the Cincinnati Reds, Cody Bellinger of the New York Yankees, Shea Langeliers of the Athletics, Mike Paredes of the Minnesota Twins, Josh Jung of the Texas Rangers, Spencer Arrighetti of the Houston Astros, and Juan Soto of the New York Mets.

The Pittsburgh Pirates have made a trade, acquiring right fielder Johnathan Rodríguez from the Baltimore Orioles in exchange for cash. The Athletics have also made a trade, acquiring right-hander Scott Blewett from the St. Louis Cardinals in exchange for cash.
